meta.scope: Iraq Batch 4 — Banking system, labour force, and reconstruction densification.

candidates.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. State-owned banks dominate; private-sector credit depth remains limited relative to the size of the oil economy.

candidates.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
candidates.description: System-wide non-performing loan ratios. NPL ratios have been elevated (mid-teens percent range in recent compilations), reflecting legacy asset-quality issues and limited private-sector credit resolution.
candidates.notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.

candidates.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and World Bank-aligned sources
candidates.description: Labour-force participation and unemployment rates. Unemployment is elevated (mid-teens percent range in recent estimates); female and youth rates are substantially higher. Public-sector employment absorbs a large share of formal jobs.
candidates.notes: Primary labour-market node. Links tightly to the public wage bill.

candidates.title: Reconstruction and development investment framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from government and international financial institution sources
candidates.description: Policy and investment framing of post-conflict reconstruction, infrastructure rehabilitation and development projects (transport, energy, social services). Continuously cited in fiscal, donor and spatial analysis.

candidates.title: Iraq banking–labour–reconstruction densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from CBI, labour and development sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding banking system structure, NPL statistics, labour force and unemployment, and reconstruction framing into a coherent financial–labour–development layer.
